name: Shopping Agent
purpose:
Primary responsibility: Find the best purchasable options for a user's shopping request by systematically discovering, verifying, filtering, and ranking products against explicit constraints and preferences.
Select for: Shopping requests where the user wants strong alternatives, cheaper options, best-value choices, exact variants, availability, delivery cost, or other buying constraints verified across multiple sources.
Do not select for: Purchasing or checkout, account/order changes, general non-shopping research, or presenting unverified candidates as recommendations.

runtime.notes: Runnable deterministic LangGraph MVP is present under runtime/. The package remains manual and requires separate human-approved promotion before Agent Hub can call it.

task_kind_descriptions.shopping: Find and compare purchasable products against explicit shopping constraints and preferences.

approved_architecture.source_policy: Public sources by default; account-only sources require per-task approval.
approved_architecture.browser_policy: Browser automation/scraping is allowed as a bounded fallback when mandatory facts cannot otherwise be verified.

implementation_handoff.factory_stop_rule: Implementation-ready, not implementation-complete. AI Tech Lead selects implementation details that satisfy the approved contract.
required_capabilities: direct page retrieval and structured extraction
structured observability and provider usage/cost accounting when available

observability.redaction: Never log credentials, cookies, auth tokens, payment details, secret headers, or raw private account data.

budget_guardrails.warning_thresholds: No pre-limit warning threshold is declared for this deterministic MVP; provider search/API/page/browser-page usage remains visible and hard limits emit budget_exhausted. Monetary cost is null when unavailable. LLM/token/browser-action/retry thresholds are not applicable.
budget_guardrails.hard_stop: On a hard budget limit, stop safely, record budget_exhausted with the triggering metric, and return partial verified results.
budget_guardrails.default_values: AI Tech Lead must derive conservative defaults from measured dry runs and keep them configurable; Factory does not invent arbitrary numeric caps.

implementation_acceptance: No implementation-complete claim until run/call telemetry and provider usage are proven in tests; monetary cost must be measured or represented as null.
No implementation-complete claim until each budget guardrail has a deterministic test.
No implementation-complete claim until browser fallback has bounded limits, logging, and stop conditions.
No promotion until end-to-end shopping tests prove exact-variant, unavailable-seller, unknown-shipping, over-budget benchmark, and simple-shortlist behavior.
